sentences.text: Hon'Ble
Shri Justice Subodh Abhyankar

On The 7 th Of August, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 31089 of 2025

Santosh Sharma
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Brijendra Gupta - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Anand Bhatt - Advocate for the respondent/EOW.
 Order
1] They are heard and perused the case diary.

2] This is the applicant's fourth bail application filed under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/ Section 439 of Cr.P.C. as he is implicated in connection with Crime No.08/2019 registered at Police Station Economic Offence Wing (EOW), Indore (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 409, 420 & 120B of IPC and Sections 6 of M.P. Protection of Depositor's Interests Act, 2000.

entities.text: Police Station Economic Offence Wing (EOW), Indore
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: M.P. Protection of Depositor's Interests Act, 2000
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 22.07.2021.
His earlier applications have already been dismissed as withdrawn.
3] The allegation against the applicant is of duping innocent investors of their hard earned money.

4] Counsel for the applicant, at the outset, has submitted that similarly situated co-accused Mukesh Sharma has already been granted bail by this Court in M.Cr.C. No.25488 of 2025 dated 27.06.2025,
and the case 2 MCRC-31089-2025 of the present applicant is akin to that of Mukesh Sharma.

Thus,
it is prayed that the application be allowed.
5] Counsel for the State has opposed the prayer.
6] On due consideration of submissions and on perusal of the case- diary, including the order passed in M.Cr.C. No.25488 of 2025, this Court is inclined to allow the present application.

7] Accordingly, maintaining parity, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application Santosh Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103454602/
1 filed by the applicant is hereby allowed.

entities.text: Santosh Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
8] Accordingly, the application is allowed and disposed of.
C.c. as per rules.
(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE Pankaj Santosh Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103454602/
